title: SSH brute force to persistence
summary: An internet host guesses the admin password on web01, logs in, reads /etc/shadow with sudo and creates a backdoor account. Three hours later a second source sprays common accounts.
provenance: 01-realtime-ai-siem tests/fixtures/auth.log replayed through 01's real pipeline (offline summariser), mapped to OCSF. The final alert chain was sent to 02's real SoarService state machine.
simulated_parts: Analyst approval click in 02 (approver analyst.dana, 4 min 10 s after the incident opened)
Isolation ran 02's mock_isolate.py in dry-run mode

stages.name: Login with stolen password
stages.description: The same source logs in successfully as admin.

stages.name: Password hashes read from /etc/shadow
stages.description: The sudo command line is cat /etc/shadow. 01 has no rule for this; 08 adds one.

stages.name: Backdoor account created
stages.description: useradd creates svc-backup with a login shell.

stages.name: Password spray
stages.description: 198.51.100.23 tries one password against many accounts.
